# Mice: Weibull regression
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_1.mice
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model {
    for(i in 1 : M) {
        for(j in 1 : N) {
            t[i, j] ~ dweib(r, mu[i])C(t.cen[i, j],)
        }
        mu[i] <- exp(beta[i])
        beta[i] ~ dnorm(0.0, 0.001)
        median[i] <- pow(log(2) * exp(-beta[i]), 1/r)
    }
    # r ~ dexp(0.001)
    r ~ dunif(0.1, 10)
    veh.control <- beta[2] - beta[1]
    test.sub <- beta[3] - beta[1]
    pos.control <- beta[4] - beta[1]
}
""", false)

build_model(data) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data)
